question: When are R21 applications due?
expected: There are multiple receipt cycles on NIH standard dates: new applications February 16, June 16 and October 16, and resubmission and revision applications March 16, July 16 and November 16 (listed from February 16, 2025 through November 16, 2027; renewals are not an allowed application type). All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization, and the notice expires January 08, 2028.
